id: \bWelcome to my home. Please take this and leave.
en: \bWelcome to my home. Please take this and leave.
it: \bBenvenuto a casa mia. Prendi questo, per favore, e vattene.
\bMi pareva di averti detto di andartene.

id: \bI can't believe I ordered too many of these. I'm just giving them away to get rid of them.
en: \bI can't believe I ordered too many of these. I'm just giving them away to get rid of them.
it: \bNon ci posso credere che ne ho ordinati troppi. Li sto regalando solo per liberarmene.

id: \bA float stone lightens the load if you know what I mean.
en: \bA float stone lightens the load if you know what I mean.
it: \bUna Pietralieve alleggerisce il carico, se capisci cosa intendo.

id: \bI came from Sinnoh to open up my first store. I had no idea they combined with the Centers here. This is the last of my products. Take it.
en: \bI came from Sinnoh to open up my first store. I had no idea they combined with the Centers here. This is the last of my products. Take it.
it: \bSono venuto da Sinnoh per aprire il mio primo negozio. Non avevo idea che qui fossero uniti ai Centri Pokémon. Questo è l'ultimo dei miei prodotti. Prendilo.
